Clinical fellow posts in anaesthesia (junior, senior, trust, teaching, research, simulation, QI and perioperative fellowships) from Health Jobs UK ↗ and BMJ Careers ↗, refreshed every morning. Filter by region, then tap a post to open it.

A fellow year can build your portfolio for ST4: teaching, QI, research or simulation time all count. Check the job plan for protected non-clinical time and the on-call commitment.

Many fellow posts are only on NHS Jobs, which can't be pulled into this feed: search NHS Jobs for clinical fellow anaesthetics posts ↗. For Scotland, check NHS Scotland Jobs ↗.
